cloud_quantity: Actual CLDFRA interpolated on native heights; no random cloud texture.
wind_coordinate_frame: Actual destaggered/rotated earth east/north/up WRF wind, fifty native mass levels sampled for display only.
phase_binding: Thompson8 large-scale: RAINNC total, SNOWNC snow+ice, GRAUPELNC graupel; resolved liquid=RAINNC-SNOWNC-GRAUPELNC. Convective RAINC and shallow RAINSH retained as unpartitioned counters, not silently rendered as liquid. Nonzero HAILNC requires a separate source binding before liquid display.
temporal_policy: 361 instantaneous weather snapshots from lead10..370; precipitation uses actual adjacent cumulative-counter differences. Never RGB-frame interpolation.
limitations: Diagnostic display sampling is not an additional weather integration or finer resolved physics.
Native negative water traces remain in the frozen files; this display does not repair or clip them.
Rain glyphs can only depict positive explicitly bound liquid; they never delete SO2 or modify its opacity.
